n6d576f4b88.headline: USD/JPY Weekly Forecast: Yen Pauses on Intervention Fears
n6d576f4b88.summary: The weekly USD/JPY forecast is slightly bearish as investors grow more cautious amid apprehensions of intervention. The yen has paused in its move.
n6d576f4b88.why: The dollar-yen pair is among the most traded currency pairs, and Japanese intervention in the currency market can cause sharp moves.

n56eb3566e0.headline: Seaside fish businessmen work tirelessly: buyers stand in line for an hour, prices do not deter
n56eb3566e0.summary: Fish traders in Nida and Palanga, Lithuania, report strong demand from tourists including from Japan, China, New Zealand, and Canada despite price increases over two years.
n56eb3566e0.why: Tourism-driven demand supports local fisheries and regional economic activity despite inflationary pressures.

n466c5ac660.headline: In Mexico, 35.5 million without sufficient income
n466c5ac660.summary: Approximately 40% of formal workers in Mexico do not earn enough to afford two basic food baskets, highlighting income insufficiency.
n466c5ac660.why: Wage insufficiency affects consumer spending and economic inequality in Latin America's second-largest economy.

n4c29056b77.headline: Adjust expenses to survive subsidy removal, PSN president advises Nigerians
n4c29056b77.summary: Nigerian authorities recommend Nigerians to adjust expenses following the removal of fuel subsidies, amid economic reforms and inflation concerns.
n4c29056b77.why: Subsidy removal affects fuel prices and inflation, influencing consumer spending and economic stability in Nigeria.

n8056891996.headline: Prices of kitchen items register further increase
n8056891996.summary: The cost of key kitchen essentials in Pakistan has increased further this week, reflecting inflationary pressures.
n8056891996.why: Rising food prices affect household budgets and consumer spending, impacting economic stability and inflation outlooks.

nf5abc6c0de.headline: China intervenes to counter the confidence crisis and protect the yuan
nf5abc6c0de.summary: China is taking measures to stabilize the yuan amid economic uncertainty caused by defaults in real estate and financial sectors.
nf5abc6c0de.why: Currency stability is crucial for China's economic growth and foreign investment, impacting global markets and commodity prices.
nf5abc6c0de.why_moved: Currency interventions are aimed at restoring confidence and stabilizing the yuan during economic headwinds.

n032fca2343.headline: The grain deal format must become a thing of the past; Ukraine needs port unblocking for all goods – FRU
n032fca2343.summary: Grain exports from Ukrainian ports have reached only 40% of the pre-war cargo base, according to the source. The article argues for unblocking ports for all goods rather than a grain-only arrangement.
n032fca2343.why: Ukraine is a major grain exporter, and port access affects global wheat and corn supply and prices.

ncb7d569495.headline: Electricity tariffs: Possible increases in bills in September
ncb7d569495.summary: Electricity tariffs that providers will announce for September are expected to be inflated. The main cause cited is an unfavourable development that the input does not fully describe.
ncb7d569495.why: Retail electricity tariffs directly affect household costs and inflation in Greece, and are closely tied to wholesale energy prices.

n97231ba88a.headline: Doubts over the continuity of China's economic miracle
n97231ba88a.summary: China is going through a difficult period due to defaults by real estate and financial companies. The government has had to intervene to counter the effects, according to the report.
n97231ba88a.why: China is the world's second-largest economy, so its growth trajectory and property-sector stress affect global commodity demand and risk appetite.

n35103eab05.headline: Massa has no luck for setbacks: why the 'contado con liqui' rate, the dollar used by companies, soared
n35103eab05.summary: After the blue dollar fell sharply following a surge between Monday and Wednesday, the contado con liquidación rate, used by companies, jumped, according to iProfesional.
n35103eab05.why: The contado con liquidación rate is an implied exchange rate used by companies to move funds out of Argentina, and its gap with official rates signals currency controls and capital flow pressure.

n1c59df44b6.headline: Kaminoseki Would Receive Nuclear Fuel
n1c59df44b6.summary: A small Japanese town said it has accepted a geological survey to determine whether it could serve as an interim storage site for nuclear fuel. The announcement came on Friday.
n1c59df44b6.why: Japan relies heavily on nuclear power, and nuclear fuel storage policy affects utility planning and the country's energy supply. Site decisions can take years and face local consent processes.
